current_point.claim: 提出一种结合细粒度和粗粒度注意力的Transformer变体模型（Museformer），用于音乐生成；其中细粒度注意力使每个token直接关注与音乐结构最相关小节的所有token，粗粒度注意力使每个token只关注其他小节的总结信息而非每个具体token。
current_point.claim_en: We propose Museformer, a Transformer model with a novel fine- and coarse-grained attention for music generation: with the fine-grained attention, a token directly attends to all the tokens of the bars most relevant to music structures; with the coarse-grained attention, a token only attends to the summarization of the other bars rather than each token of them.
source_locations: 第三章 3.2.3 细-粗粒度注意力机制
technical_features: 结合细粒度和粗粒度注意力的Transformer变体模型
细粒度注意力：每个token直接关注与音乐结构最相关小节的所有token
粗粒度注意力：每个token只关注其他小节的总结信息，而非每个具体token
该模型用于音乐生成任务
technical_features_en: A Transformer model with a novel fine- and coarse-grained attention
Fine-grained attention: a token directly attends to all the tokens of the bars most relevant to music structures
Coarse-grained attention: a token only attends to the summarization of the other bars rather than each token of them
